params.caption: 🎮 New Cyberpunk 2077 mod turns Night City into an online RP sandbox A fan multiplayer project called Open//77 lets servers of often more than 100 players roam Night City together, with roleplay servers in the style of GTA Online. It arrives a month after NightCoop, a separate mod for playing the main story with up to eight friends. 🕒 Nov 9, 2026 · 19:13 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: IGN #Cyberpunk2077 #Mods #GamingNews
